{{Quote|Two Jedi in the control room? That is impossible. How could they have gotten past security?|TX-21, after receiving a report from the Geonosian spy|<ref name="WF" />}}
This '''Geonosian spy''', a [[Gender/Legends|male]] being, was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was sleeping in the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] below a [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]], which was surrounded by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. After being accidentally awakened by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who were trying to destruct the foundry by destroying its main generator, the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] started to follow their track. After spotting them and hearing about their plan to destroy the generator, he swiftly informed [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] about it. The Archduke then confronted the Jedi with his warriors, but they were unsuccessful to prevent the destruction of the generator, and the foundry was destroyed.

==Biography==
The [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual, was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and served under the command of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]],<ref name="WF" /> the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="DBPtL">{{DB|character|pogglethelesser|Poggle the Lesser}}</ref> During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="WF" /> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the Geonosian was located in a [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]], which manufactured [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], when it was surrounded by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces. The spy was sleeping in a small hall in the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] beneath the foundry, when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] stumbled across the hall. The pair was tasked with destroying the main generator of the foundry, which would cause the whole factory to collapse.<ref name="WF" />

[[File:Geo_spy_reports.png|thumb|left|200px|The spy reports in to Poggle the Lesser and TX-21]]
When the Padawans tried to sneak past the hall, the sleeping Geonosian spy unknowingly placed his hand on Offee's head, who quickly halted. The Jedi managed to escape and the pair continued their journey, but the Geonosian awoke only seconds after. Unsure about the situation, he armed himself with a [[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|Geonosian sonic blaster]] and started to follow the Jedi. He soon caught up with them, and, staying unseen, spied on the Padawans and heard them speaking about their mission to destroy the generator. The spy then quickly ran to report to Poggle the Lesser, who was conferring with his<ref name="WF" /> [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]]<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> [[TX-21/Legends|TX-21]].<ref name="WFep">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode206.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Weapons Factory}}</ref> After the Geonosian spy revealed the presence of the Jedi duo to the Warlord and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], TX-21 questioned how the Jedi managed to get past the security of the foundry. Poggle the Lesser nonetheless ordered the Jedi to be stopped, and left to confront Offee and Tano with TX-21, couple of [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|Geonosian warriors]] and a [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]]. Despite this, the generator was eventually destroyed by the Jedi, and the factory was ruined by the following explosion.<ref name="WF" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Geo_spy_spying.png|thumb|right|200px|The Geonosian following the Jedi intruders]]
After being accidentally awakened by the Jedi, the Geonosian spy, uncertain about the trespassers, chose to investigate the catacombs. When he found the intruders, correctly identifying them as Jedi, and heard about their plan to destroy the foundry, he was seemingly angered, and rushed to report to his superiors rather than trying to eliminate the Jedi by himself. Before giving his report to Poggle the Lesser, the Geonosian hastily bowed his head.<ref name="WF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Geonosian appeared in "[[Weapons Factory]]," the sixth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[November 13]], [[2009]]. While the Geonosian was not identified in the episode, he is called a "Geonosian spy" in the episode's accompanying [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|online guide]].<ref name="WFep" />
